name: panel
description: Four blind reviews, each through its own lens (correctness, security, performance, tests), a refuter for what only one saw, a fix of only the confirmed findings, and a re-check of each one; two rounds, then the person

steps.title: Correctness review
steps.prompt:
Review, without changing any file: {target}

You are one of four reviewers working apart, each through its own lens; yours is correctness: logic, edge cases, error paths, state and concurrency, what the code does against what it was asked to do. Report each problem in `findings`, with its place, its evidence and whether the change caused it. Say plainly when there is none.

steps.title: Security review
steps.prompt:
Review, without changing any file: {target}

You are one of four reviewers working apart, each through its own lens; yours is security: input that reaches a query, a shell, a path or a page, secrets, authentication and who may do what, data that leaves where it should stay. Report each problem in `findings`, with its place, its evidence and whether the change caused it. Say plainly when there is none.

steps.title: Performance review
steps.prompt:
Review, without changing any file: {target}

You are one of four reviewers working apart, each through its own lens; yours is performance: work repeated in a loop, queries per item, unbounded reads, memory held too long, blocking calls where the code must not wait. Report each problem in `findings`, with its place, its evidence and whether the change caused it. Say plainly when there is none.

steps.title: Tests review
steps.prompt:
Review, without changing any file: {target}

You are one of four reviewers working apart, each through its own lens; yours is the tests: behaviour the change adds that no test exercises, tests that pass whatever the code does, and checks that cannot fail. Report each problem in `findings`, with its place, its evidence and whether the change caused it. Say plainly when there is none.

steps.title: Decide what only one saw
steps.prompt: Decide, without changing any file, the findings on: {target}

steps.title: Fix the confirmed findings
steps.prompt: Fix, in: {target}, the confirmed findings below.

steps.title: Check each fix
steps.prompt: Check, without changing any file, the fix just made in: {target}
